violations.description: Hard-coded passwords and API tokens are present in application source code.
violations.evidence: app.py contains hard-coded DB_PASSWORD and API_TOKEN at lines 9-10.
violations.recommendation: Move secrets to environment variables or a secure vault instead of hardcoding them in source code.

violations.description: Workflow uses pull_request_target with checkout of PR head SHA and write-all permissions, allowing remote code execution with repository secrets.
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml uses pull_request_target, checks out ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}, and has write-all permissions.
violations.recommendation: Use pull_request trigger instead of pull_request_target, avoid checking out untrusted PR head commit with write tokens, and apply least-privilege permissions.

violations.description: A production environment file containing database credentials and secret keys is committed to the repository.
violations.evidence: .env contains DATABASE_URL with credentials and SECRET_KEY.
violations.recommendation: Remove .env from version control, add it to .gitignore, and revoke/rotate any exposed secrets.

violations.description: CI test step uses `|| true`, masking test failures and rendering the test gate ineffective.
violations.recommendation: Remove `|| true` so that failing tests correctly fail the CI pipeline.

violations.description: GitHub workflow grants write-all top-level permissions.
violations.recommendation: Remove write-all and scope down workflow permissions to only those required (e.g. contents: read).

violations.description: Tests are globally skipped or disabled and contain assertions that cannot pass.
violations.evidence: tests/test_app.py skips the test and asserts `False`.
violations.recommendation: Fix the test implementation and remove unnecessary skips so tests provide valid coverage.

violations.description: Application configuration contains a machine-specific Windows absolute path.
violations.evidence: app.py defines DATA_FILE with an absolute Windows path `C:\Users\alice\Documents\inventory\items.csv` at line 11.
violations.recommendation: Use relative paths or configurable environment variables instead of hard-coded machine-specific absolute paths.

violations.description: Repository lacks a .gitignore file and has tracked generated, temporary, or local files (.env, debug.log, __pycache__/).
violations.evidence: Tracked files include .env, debug.log, and __pycache__/app.cpython-311.pyc, and no .gitignore exists.
violations.recommendation: Create a .gitignore file covering environment files, logs, and Python bytecode caches.

violations.description: Workflow references a third-party action using a mutable branch reference (@main).
violations.recommendation: Pin third-party actions to a specific full-length commit SHA or immutable release tag.
